t: Rick Steves - Wikipedia
s: 1 week ago - Richard John Steves Jr. (born May 10, 1955) is an American travel writer, activist, and television personality. His travel philosophy encourages people to explore less-frequented areas of destinations and to become immersed in the local people's way of life. Starting in 2000, he hosted Rick Steves' Europe, a travel series on public television.
